evidence.quoted_text:
with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=filename.parent, delete=False) as stream:
        stream.write(data)
        stream.flush()
        os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        temporary = stream.name
    os.replace(temporary, filename)
evidence.reason: The current `atomic` implementation creates a named temporary file with `delete=False` but only assigns `temporary` after `write`, `flush`, and `fsync`; if any of those or `os.replace` fails, the staging file is left behind. A retry creates another staging file, so repeated failures can leak disk space. This is an ordinary cleanup defect in the existing atomic-write behavior, and no supplied history shows it fixed.
